revenueModel.text: Customers pay regulated rates, approved by the PPUC, for water and wastewater service, plus municipalities pay for billing and collection services.
revenueModel.evidence: Increases in revenues are generally dependent on the Company's ability to obtain rate increases from the PPUC in a timely manner and in adequate amounts and to increase volumes of water sold through increased consumption and increases in the number of customers served.
